title: ClaimScope: Reproducible Repository-Level Reanalysis of Artifact-Size Reporting in Agentic Pull Requests
description: Research software and reproducibility materials for an analysis of 1,699 pull requests across 440 repositories. The archive includes the pinned published labels, original metric detector, source-linked comment experiments, 823 PR report classifications, fixed probability sample, exact finite-population inference, and independent review tools. The archived public comment corpus supports offline detector replay. Additional source records have identifiers and digests for recovery and review.
